title: geodorum recurvum
intro: Geodorum recurvum, commonly known as the 'Twisted Geodorum', is a type of orchid that belongs to the Asparagaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of fever and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Geodorum recurvum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
